findingDetails.title: The shipped tree lets the 033-system-speckit-v4 phase folder resolve to error under its own generated-metadata integrity gate
findingDetails.evidence: Executed check+resolve with orchestrator defaults returns error / SOURCE_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH for the 033 parent and the archived z_archive/010 folder; rule pushed unconditionally (orchestrator.ts:1068); grandfather default false (capability-flags.ts:97-98); checker source and dist byte-identical at v4.0.0.3 and HEAD; folder docs and metadata tag-identical; range changed only graph-metadata.json (01162dfe43) without a re-derive; digest write and last spec.md edit share pre-range commit 06b231a8db; 279-packet sweep: 10 violating folders, 7 resolve to info.
findingDetails.recommendation: Re-derive the folder's graph metadata with the known generate-description/backfill pair as part of the release tail; if a re-derive of an untouched folder cannot reproduce the stored digest, treat that as the tooling signal.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Ran the repo's own checker and resolver on the folders, compared metadata and checker blobs across the tag, read rule wiring and flag defaults, and swept 279 packets.
